provenance.abstraction_rationale: Single-API pattern for torch.softmax: mathematically equivalent permute or transpose reorderings around a softmax operation can produce small numerical differences.
unresolved_information: The report does not provide an official root cause or fix status; root_cause_claims is empty and fix_status is unknown.
The captured reproduction text contains an unclosed code fence, so the reproduction snippet may be truncated.
The report environment is CPU-only and does not state whether the discrepancy also occurs on CUDA or other backends.

conditions.subject: input tensor
conditions.predicate: is permuted or transposed before or after torch.softmax

conditions.subject: input tensor
conditions.predicate: uses a floating-point dtype (float32 or float64)

operation_context.description: The reporter compared torch.softmax applied along the original dimension before a row/column permute against torch.softmax applied along dimension 0 after the permute.

hypotheses.description: Numerical differences arise when torch.softmax is evaluated on tensors whose layout has been changed by permute or transpose, so mathematically equivalent orders do not produce identical outputs.

observed_failure.description: torch.softmax produces slightly different results when applied before versus after an inverse permutation or transpose; the float32 example shows a max absolute difference of 2.9802e-08.

historical_oracle.condition: The two computation orders should produce identical results; the reporter observed a nonzero max absolute difference of 2.9802e-08 for the float32 example.
